title: What Is Semiconductor Dicing? The Process Flow, Blade vs. Laser, and Causes of Chipping and Cracks, Illustrated
excerpt: Semiconductor dicing is the back-end process that cuts a wafer finished in the front-end process into individual chips. This beginner's guide illustrates the process flow, the differences between blade, laser, and plasma dicing, and quality points such as chipping, cracks, particles, and misalignment.
